title: Nanoluciferase Assay in C. elegans
author: Emily Troemel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7mhhk36

steps.title: Grow and Treat Worms
steps.instruction: Grow and/or treat worms as required, typically on 3.5 or 6 cm NGM plates seeded with OP50-1. Use well-fed adults for the highest signal.

substeps.instruction: Use N2 as a no-Nanoluciferase control

Use ERT513 (unc-119 (ed3) III; jySi35 [pET618 (vha-6p::NANOLUC::unc-54 3' UTR, unc-119 (+)]) or ERT529 (unc-119 (ed3) III; jySi40 [pET635 (vha-6p::NANOLUC::3XFLAG::unc-54 3' UTR, unc-119 (+)]) as Nanoluciferase (NanoLuc) expressing controls

steps.title: Prepare Lysate (1 to <50 Worms)
steps.instruction: Prepare worm lysate for small samples using the following procedure:

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.7 ml microfuge tubes containing 80-100 ul 1x Lysis Buffer
Pick worms into Lysis Buffer, ensuring they are released from the pick
Add approximately 5-10 Silicon Carbide beads to the tube
Vortex samples for 4 minutes using a Disruptor Genie set to 4°C
Spin down sample for 1 minute at max speed with a table top centrifuge
Optional: Transfer supernatant to a new 1.7 ml tube and freeze at -80°C for later use

steps.title: Prepare Lysate (50 to <1,000 Worms)
steps.instruction: Prepare worm lysate for medium samples using the following procedure:

substeps.instruction: Wash worms from growth plate into 1.7 ml tubes with M9-T (M9 with 0.1% Tween-20)
Spin worms down at 2,000xg for 1 minute and remove supernatant to the 100 ul line
Add 300 ul of 1X Lysis Buffer
Spin worms down at 2,000xg for 1 minute and remove supernatant to the 100 ul line
Add approximately 10-15 Silicon Carbide beads to the tube
Vortex samples for 4 minutes using a Disruptor Genie set to 4°C
Spin down sample for 1 minute at max speed with a table top centrifuge
Optional: Transfer supernatant to a new 1.7 ml tube and freeze at -80°C for later use

steps.title: Prepare Lysate (≥ 1,000 Worms)
steps.instruction: Prepare worm lysate for large samples using the following procedure:

substeps.instruction: Wash worms from growth plate into 15 ml tubes with M9-T (M9 with 0.1% Tween-20)
Spin worms down at 2,000xg for 1 minute and remove supernatant to the 300 ul line
Transfer worms to 1.7 ml tubes using a glass Pasteur pipette
Add 300 ul of 1X Lysis Buffer
Spin worms down at 2,000xg for 1 minute and remove supernatant to the 100 ul line (or above if the pellet is larger)
Add approximately 15-20 Silicon Carbide beads to the tube
Vortex samples for 4 minutes using a Disruptor Genie set to 4°C
Spin down sample for 1 minute at max speed with a table top centrifuge
Optional: Transfer supernatant to a new 1.7 ml tube and freeze at -80°C for later use

steps.title: Prepare Plate for Luminescence
steps.instruction: Set up the white 96-well plate for the NanoLuc assay.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 50 ul of the worm lysate (supernatant) to a well of a white 96-well plate
Prepare NanoGlo Reagent (1 part NanoGlo Substrate + 50 parts NanoGlo Buffer)
Add NanoGlo Reagent to each well containing lysate: 25 ul for samples < 1,000 worms, or 50 ul for samples ≥ 1,000 worms
Use a repeater pipette to avoid bubbles; do not resuspend by pipetting up and down
Agitate the plate for 10 minutes at room temperature using a plate shaker

steps.title: Configure NovoStar Plate Reader
steps.instruction: Initialize and configure the plate reader software and hardware.

substeps.instruction: Switch on the plate reader and open the black sliding door on top
Install the optic fiber for luminescent measurement and close the sliding door tightly
Open 'NovoStar' software and navigate to Setup > Reader configuration > Luminescence
Navigate to Test setup > Test protocol > Bright Glo > Edit > Layout and mark samples and blanks according to plate design
Prepare at least two wells containing 1X Lysis Buffer with NanoGlo Reagent as blanks (ideally vortexed with Silicon Carbide beads)

steps.title: Measure Luminescent Signal
steps.instruction: Execute the measurement and export the data.

substeps.instruction: Choose Measure > Plate out, insert the uncovered plate, and select Plate in
Set shaking to linear shaking 1mm with 10s additional shaking time before reading and 0.2 sec positioning delay
Adjust Gain on the well with the highest expected signal (max gain is 4095); if unknown, use the '96' button to determine the best well
Select Measure > Measure (signal is measured for 1 second per well without filters)
Open results via Results > Open last test (MARS software) and export data using the Excel button

steps.title: System Shutdown
steps.instruction: Properly shut down the equipment and software.

substeps.instruction: Close MARS software
Remove the plate
Close NovoStar software
Shut down the computer
Switch off the NovoStar plate reader
